Agent brand icons

The image files live in src/studio/assets/agent-brands/ and identify the
Agent tools and model sources that ShowAI can connect to.

Desktop app icons are taken from the vendors' distributed applications:
Codex from the ChatGPT macOS app; Kimi Work, Cursor, Qoder, WorkBuddy,
DeepSeek Harness and Antigravity from their respective macOS app bundles.

Claude Code: https://www.anthropic.com/press-kit (ClaudeIcon-Square.png)
Gemini CLI: https://geminicli.com/icon.png
Kimi Code CLI: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/blob/main/web/public/logo.png
OpenCode: https://opencode.ai/brand/files/opencode-logo-light.svg

openai.svg, openrouter.svg, deepseek.svg and kimi.svg are from LobeHub Icons:
https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons
They are distributed under the MIT license in LICENSE.lobe-icons.txt.

kimi.svg is kimi-color.svg from @lobehub/icons-static-svg 1.95.1 with the
letter drawn in black so it remains visible on the light icon tile. It
identifies Moonshot model sources.

Brand names and marks belong to their respective owners.
